use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Math.sqrt

step(value: long) -> long =>
    if (value % 2L) == 0L then
        cast long(sqrt(cast(value)))
    else
        cast long(cast(value) * sqrt(cast(value)))
    fi

stats(start: long) -> (int, long, int) => (
    let current mut = start
    let terms mut = 0
    let highest mut = start
    let at mut = 0

    while current != 1L do
        current = step(current)
        terms = terms + 1

        if current > highest then
            highest = current
            at = terms
        fi
    od

    (terms, highest, at)
)

write_line("  n   l                h  i")

for n in 20::39 do
    let (terms, highest, at) = stats(cast(n))
    write_line("{n,3}  {terms,3}  {highest,17:N0}  {at}")
od
